name: Eaton
bio: A stockman named only as Eaton sat on the committee of five that drafted by-laws for the Bad Lands Live Stock Association in March 1884. The same surname appears among the stockmen at whose request a meeting of Little Missouri stockmen was called in December 1884.

moments.label: Sat on committee drafting stockmen's association by-laws
